heading: Designing, coding & capturing moments.
paragraphs: I like making things and being involved in the whole process. That can mean designing a UI, writing the code behind it, figuring out how an interaction should work, or taking a camera out and looking for a good shot.

My background is in computer science, but I've always been interested in the space between technology and visual design. I use AI-assisted software development alongside my usual tools to prototype ideas, solve problems, and get things working quickly.

Off-screen I'm usually at the gym or boxing, out walking the dog, losing slowly at chess, editing a video, or grinding Duolingo Spanish. Grew up in Switzerland, Italian roots — I like things precise and I like them to look good.
